verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook is an AI chat and research assistant, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only source uploads (files, websites, YouTube, Google Docs, Play Books), grounded chat and generated artifacts. Nothing shows the product can connect to MCP servers or call external tools, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
